_comment: Defines the path the sync script takes through Homebase and how it recognizes the data on each page. Edit this file (not the code) when Homebase's layout changes or these placeholder keywords need calibrating against the real site.

hours_report._comment: Confirmed against a real Timesheets screenshot: columns are Team member / Worked / Total paid breaks / Total unpaid breaks / Issues / Actions. The total is embedded in the Worked cell as 'Total: X hrs Y min' — extracted by regex, not a dedicated hours column. Prefer the page's own 'Pay period' toggle over summing daily views once its URL/param is confirmed.

trade_board._comment: Confirmed against real screenshots: there is no separate trade-board page. A shift released and picked up shows as a flagged cell (orange, warning icon, 'Open Shift approved') directly in the regular weekly Schedule Builder grid, under the covering employee's own row — that row IS the picker's identity, confirmed sufficient (no click-through needed). Scraped by visual position (nearest day-header column, nearest employee-name row), not DOM structure, since this page is a calendar grid rather than a table. {date} is filled in with any date inside the target week (Homebase's own weeks run Sunday-Saturday and it resolves the rest). Sync failures here are isolated from the hours sync and never block it.
